title: The Linden Row Courier

headings.text: Repair café moves to the library

key_sentences: The flooded lower path has been rebuilt with a gravel surface that drains far better than the old one.
Seven plots are still free, and anyone who lives in the parish can apply for one.
The first session in the new room is on Saturday 11 April from ten until one.
Priya will be at the community centre every Tuesday morning for anyone who wants to raise a problem in person.
The committee meets on the first Thursday of every month at half past seven, and all residents are welcome to attend.
Both can be collected from the community centre office during opening hours.

list_items.text: Good Friday collections move to Saturday 4 April.
Easter Monday collections move to Tuesday 7 April.
Garden waste collections restart on 13 April.
– to ask the council for a pedestrian crossing outside the primary school;
– to buy two new benches for the village green;
– to hold the summer fair on Saturday 27 June;
– to look for a new treasurer from September.
